text:
tess: Quick sync  Wes aiming to publish the v1.8 announcement tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final changelog link + stable docs URL by EOD so we can freeze copy and schedule socials.
liam: Acknowledged. Changelog PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/439. Will add canonical docs path and redirects before EOD.
jordana: Design deadline: need the benchmark PNG + alt text by 17:00 so we can make hero + socials. otherwise well have to use the smaller chart.
samira: Benchmarks are uploaded to the PR comment (CSV + alt chart). Short marketing line suggestion: "~20% lower unit cost vs. previous release, with comparable 95th-percentile latency." Keep it high-level.
tess: Nice. Marketing will standardize phrasing to "unit-cost improvement" in all channels. Avoid words like 'cut' or 'savings'.
liam: Docs canonical URL will be: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/v1.8/overview. I added an anchor for the KV cache migration and a tiny runbook link.
product-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/commit/fedcba9876543210
deploy-bot: staging: deploy succeeded 2024-11-05T19:12:07Z. prod: scheduled 2024-11-06 08:30 PT. rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m checks.
ops: Heads-up  migration note for KV cache config included in the docs. Self-hosted customers should review pre-upgrade checklist: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/v1.8-upgrade.
jordana: Also need the short CTA URL for webinar sign-ups and the on-demand link. Will wrap in the hero.
liam: Webinar sign-up: https://redwood.com/webinar/v1-8-live. On-demand: https://redwood.com/webinar/v1-8/recording.
tess: Perfect. Can support confirm inbound lead tagging and SFDC webhook?
ops: Confirmed  inbound leads will be tagged "release_v1_8" and routed to the new SFDC queue. Webhook endpoint live.
liam: Small technical note for the changelog: include migration snippet so customers know to set batch and cache knobs. Example in docs: ```
# example config
redwood.kv_cache.enabled=true
redwood.batch.max_tokens=1024
```
samira: Thanks. Marketing will reference the migration note and link to the runbook rather than dump config in the post. Short blurb in blog: "See upgrade checklist for self-hosted instructions."
tess: Ok locking copy to the approved phrasing. Anyone see blockers?
liam: No blockers from eng. All tests green.
product-bot: Canary started 2024-11-06T08:30:02Z  5% traffic.
deps: (silent)
ops: Canary passed 30m checks, progressing to 25%.
tess: Once canary hits 25% and health is green I'll hit publish at 09:00 PT and post the announcement thread. Will share final asset bundle here. Thanks everyone. :tada:
